project: Why do planetary orbits not generally decay?
scientific_conclusion: Conservative gravity does not generically make a planetary orbit spiral inward. Any secular change must be attributed to a declared signed energy/angular-momentum flux or changing central mass; tides, solar mass loss, many-body perturbations, and future giant-branch engulfment are distinct mechanisms.
independent_review_reason: The deliverable is a static, design-only research document with no high-risk architecture, security, persistence, or data-migration modification.
